pack <- function(x) {
  nows <- attr(x, "noWS", exact = TRUE)
  if (is.null(nows)) {
    encoded <- list(type = "null")
  } else {
    encoded <- list(type = typeof(nows), value = nows)
  }
  list(
    text = as.vector(x),
    html = isTRUE(attr(x, "html", exact = TRUE)),
    class = class(x),
    noWS = encoded
  )
}

def encode_nows(no_ws):
    if no_ws is None:
        return {"type": "null"}
    if is_na(no_ws):
        return {"type": "character", "value": None}
    if isinstance(no_ws, str):
        return {"type": "character", "value": no_ws}
    if isinstance(no_ws, bool):
        return {"type": "logical", "value": no_ws}
    if isinstance(no_ws, int):
        return {"type": "integer", "value": no_ws}
    if isinstance(no_ws, float):
        return {"type": "double", "value": no_ws}
    if isinstance(no_ws, (list, tuple)):
        if len(no_ws) == 0:
            return {"type": "character", "value": []}
        values = [None if is_na(item) else item for item in no_ws]
        if len(values) == 1:
            return {"type": "character", "value": values[0]}
        return {"type": "character", "value": values}
    return {"type": type(no_ws).__name__, "value": no_ws}


def pack(value):
    return {
        "text": str(value),
        "html": True if value.html else False,
        "class": list(value.r_class),
        "noWS": encode_nows(value.noWS),
    }


def message(call):
    try:
        call()
    except ValueError as exc:
        return str(exc)
    raise AssertionError("expected an error")

fmt_dep <- function(prefix, x) {
  src <- paste0(
    names(x$src),
    "=",
    vapply(x$src, function(el) paste(as.character(el), collapse = " "), character(1)),
    collapse = ","
  )
  script <- if (is.null(x$script)) "NULL" else paste(as.character(x$script), collapse = " ")
  style <- if (is.null(x$stylesheet)) "NULL" else paste(as.character(x$stylesheet), collapse = " ")
  flag <- if (isTRUE(x$all_files)) "TRUE" else if (identical(x$all_files, FALSE)) "FALSE" else as.character(x$all_files)
  paste0(
    prefix, " returns ", as.character(x$name), " ", as.character(x$version),
    " src=", src, " script=", script, " stylesheet=", style, " all_files=", flag, "."
  )
}

  "jqueryui", "1.11.4", c(href = "shared/jqueryui"),

)

  ),

)

encode_names <- function(nms) {
  if (is.null(nms)) return(NULL)
  lapply(nms, function(n) if (is.na(n)) list(na = TRUE) else n)
}

encode_el <- function(el, type) {
  if (type == "double") {
    if (is.nan(el)) return(list(nan = TRUE))
    if (is.na(el)) return(list(na = TRUE))
    if (is.infinite(el)) return(list(inf = if (el > 0) 1L else -1L))
    return(as.character(el))
  }
  if (is.na(el)) return(list(na = TRUE))
  if (type == "complex") return(as.character(el))
  el
}

encode_atomic <- function(x) {
  type <- typeof(x)
  n <- length(x)
  data <- vector("list", n)
  if (n > 0L) {
    for (i in seq_len(n)) data[[i]] <- encode_el(x[[i]], type)
  }
  list(t = type, names = encode_names(names(x)), data = data)
}

encode <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(list(t = "null"))
  if (is.list(x)) {
    out <- list(
      t = "list",
      names = encode_names(names(x)),
      items = unname(lapply(x, encode))
    )
    cls <- class(x)
    if (!(length(cls) == 1L && identical(cls, "list"))) out$class <- cls
    return(out)
  }
  encode_atomic(x)
}

call_dep <- function(expr, namespace = FALSE) {
  expr <- substitute(expr)
  envir <- if (isTRUE(namespace)) getNamespace("htmltools") else parent.frame()
  warns <- character()
  res <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      list(ok = TRUE, value = eval(expr, envir)),
      warning = function(w) {
        warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) list(ok = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(e))
  )
  res$warning <- warns
  res
}

encode_run <- function(res) {
  list(
    error = if (isTRUE(res$ok)) NULL else res$error,
    warning = if (length(res$warning) == 0) NULL else as.list(res$warning),
    value = if (isTRUE(res$ok)) encode(res$value) else NULL
  )
}

    if mode == "double":

    if isinstance(value, Listing):

join_names <- function(nms) {
  if (length(nms) == 0) "" else paste(nms, collapse = sep)
}

pack_one <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(list(type = "null"))
  if (is.symbol(x)) {
    return(list(type = "symbol", value = paste(as.character(x), collapse = "")))
  }
  if (inherits(x, "shiny.tag.list")) return(pack_tag(x))
  if (is.list(x)) {
    nms <- names(x)
    return(list(
      type = "list",
      n = length(x),
      names = if (is.null(nms)) NULL else join_names(nms),
      items = unname(lapply(x, pack_one))
    ))
  }
  kind <- typeof(x)
  if (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x) && !(kind == "double" && is.nan(x))) {
    return(list(type = kind, missing = TRUE))
  }
  if (length(x) == 1) return(list(type = kind, value = x))
  list(type = kind, n = length(x), value = as.list(x))
}

pack_tag <- function(x) {
  list(
    type = "tagList",
    class = class(x),
    n = length(x),
    names = join_names(names(x)),
    items = unname(lapply(x, pack_one))
  )
}

  warnings <- character()
  value <- withCallingHandlers(

    warning = function(w) {
      warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  note <- paste(warnings, collapse = "\n---\n")
  if (inherits(value, "error")) {
    list(error = conditionMessage(value), value = NULL, warnings = note)
  } else {
    list(error = NULL, value = pack_tag(value), warnings = note)
  }
}
